queries.sql: SELECT `c`.*, `c`.`name` as `customer_name`, `c`.`phone` as `customer_phone`, `b`.`name` as `barber_name`, `s`.`name` as `service_name`, `s`.`price` FROM `customers` `c` LEFT JOIN `barbers` `b` ON `b`.`id` = `c`.`barber_id` LEFT JOIN `services` `s` ON `s`.`id` = `c`.`service_id` WHERE COALESCE(c.booking_date, DATE(c.created_at)) = '2026-11-08' ORDER BY `c`.`booking_time` ASC
